how to build libmariadb


on a x86_64 system, do
    mkdir -p ~/REPO
    cd ~
    export MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4
    git clone https://github.com/mariadb-corporation/mariadb-connector-c.git
    cd  mariadb-connector-c
    mkdir build
    cd build
    cmake .. -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES="x86_64"
    make -j20
    sudo make DESTDIR=~/REPO/libmariadb-x86_64 install

then go to ~/REPO

    cd ~/REPO
    tar -cvzf libmariadb-x86_64.tar.gz libmariadb-x86_64

copy the file to your arm64 system and untar it in ~/REPO/

    cd ~/REPO
    sudo tar -xvzf  libmariadb-x86_64.tar.gz
    

Now build the arm64 version

    cd ~
    export MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4
    git clone https://github.com/mariadb-corporation/mariadb-connector-c.git
    cd  mariadb-connector-c
    mkdir build
    cd build
    cmake .. -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES="arm64"
    make -j20
    sudo make DESTDIR=~/REPO/libmariadb-arm64 install
    sudo make DESTDIR=~/REPO/libmariadb install
 
 Now merge the files
 
    cd ~/REPO/libmariadb/usr/local/lib/mariadb
    
    for X in auth_gssapi_client.so caching_sha2_password.so client_ed25519.so dialog.so mysql_clear_password.so parsec.so remote_io.so sha256_password.so
    do
        sudo lipo -arch x86_64 ~/REPO/libmariadb-x86_64/usr/local/lib/mariadb/plugin/${X}  -arch arm64 ~/REPO/libmariadb-arm64/usr/local/lib/mariadb/plugin/${X} -create -output ~/REPO/libmariadb/usr/local/lib/mariadb/plugin/${X}
    done
    sudo lipo -arch x86_64 ~/REPO/libmariadb-x86_64/usr/local/lib/mariadb/libmariadbclient.a  -arch arm64 ~/REPO/libmariadb-arm64/usr/local/lib/mariadb/libmariadbclient.a -create -output ~/REPO/libmariadb/usr/local/lib/mariadb/libmariadbclient.a
    sudo lipo -arch x86_64 ~/REPO/libmariadb-x86_64/usr/local/lib/mariadb/libmariadb.3.dylib  -arch arm64 ~/REPO/libmariadb-arm64/usr/local/lib/mariadb/libmariadb.3.dylib -create -output ~/REPO/libmariadb/usr/local/lib/mariadb/libmariadb.3.dylib
    sudo lipo -arch x86_64 ~/REPO/libmariadb-x86_64/usr/local/bin/mariadb_config  -arch arm64 ~/REPO/libmariadb-arm64/usr/local/bin/mariadb_config -create -output ~/REPO/libmariadb/usr/local/bin/mariadb_config

Now build a package

    cd ~/REPO/
    pkgbuild --root libmariadb  --ownership recommended --install-location / --version "3.4.11" --identifier <identifier>  "libmariadb-3.4.11.pkg"
    codesign -s <signature>  libmariadb-3.4.11.pkg
